context: A coach previews an upcoming match with a teen athlete
purpose: Teach: 国旗/比例/水平/部員/滝/ボート/高まる/翼

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 明日の試合、いよいよだな。会場には大きな国旗が掲揚されるらしい。
lines.en: Tomorrow's match is finally here. They'll apparently raise a huge national flag at the venue.
lines.style: Calm, authoritative coach tone with measured pacing and quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、緊張が高まる一方です…胸がドキドキしてます。
lines.en: Whoa, my nerves just keep rising... my heart is pounding.
lines.style: Nervous teen voice, slightly breathy and youthful, polite to coach.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 落ち着け。お前の実力は練習量に比例している。自信を持っていい。
lines.en: Calm down. Your ability is proportional to the practice you've put in. You can be confident.
lines.style: Firm, reassuring delivery with steady low tone, like a seasoned officer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい。相手チームの部員、みんな体がでかくて、滝みたいな汗かいてました…
lines.en: Yes. The members of the opposing team are all huge, and they were sweating like a waterfall.
lines.style: Anxious teen describing observation, voice trailing slightly with uncertainty.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 見た目に惑わされるな。ボートを漕ぐようなリズムで、呼吸を整えろ。
lines.en: Don't be fooled by appearances. Steady your breathing with a rhythm like rowing a boat.
lines.style: Instructive, paternal coaching voice, slow and grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 水平に視線を保って、目の前の一球に集中します。
lines.en: I'll keep my gaze level and focus on the ball right in front of me.
lines.style: Determined teen committing to advice, voice firming with resolve.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そうだ。今のお前には翼がある。思い切って羽ばたいてこい。
lines.en: That's right. You have wings now. Spread them and fly out there boldly.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging finale from coach, slight smile audible in voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、監督!絶対に勝ちます!
lines.en: Thank you, Coach! I'll definitely win!
lines.style: Energized teen shout, voice rising with renewed courage and gratitude.
